## Lab

Materials for this practical can be downloaded from this [Google Drive Link](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10MxDjaNVwez6mTuGxVRv98r7I8U9mHpt). You will need to download the following files from the folder:

-   smoothingSimulatedData.forWorkshop.Rmd (open this file in RStudio)

-   Tex14_methCounts.Rdata (Dataset 1)

-   Tex14unmethCounts.Rdata (Dataset 2)

Note: make sure all three files are stored in the same folder after downloading it.
